command.purpose: Use the existing encrypted vault first; preserve same-task inventory, scoped credentials and privacy.

Use $cover-project before substantive suite expansion: assign separable behavior, state/recovery and persistence testing to one bounded worker. Routine fixes and explicit single-agent constraints stay direct. Return tests, scoped metrics and fault evidence; use retained regression and assertion-design references.

Use $goal-supervisor for approved #SV supervision with task-based model routing, fresh compact worker context, parallel owners and coordinated checks; preserve human authority, fidelity and independent final acceptance.

Use $goal-prompt to draft verifiable /goal objectives with useful parallel work, task-based model routing and fresh compact worker context; preserve required checks, human preferences, scope and supervision authority.
Use $justification-audit to test what earns its place before optimization, compare alternatives, and expose assumptions.

Use $orchestration for isolated parallel writers, independent testing/review and one integration lead, with task-based model routing and fresh compact worker context; preserve required checks, actual capacity and authority.
Use $outcome-loop for explicitly iterative operations with bounded retries, reconciliation and requested reporting.
Use $production-algorithm to question, delete, simplify, accelerate, and automate; optionally pair with $justification-audit.

Use $launch-video-studio to discover formats and create/edit/sync launch videos through the registered durable managed local Studio; quietly check repo/installed Studio/enabled-film maintenance on every Studio prompt, do nothing when healthy, preserve development and legacy remote-primary routing; explicit Remotion projects use the official plugin and retained supplemental recipes.
Use $monochrome-workspace to reuse the clean white-and-black workspace design kit; Impeccable is optional.
Use $image-art-direction to iterate image briefs and edits; load OpenAI Aesthetic Images only for that requested visual style.
Use $sire to research a blocker, compare solutions, recommend a plan, and start a native goal only after your approval.
Use $skill-cleaner for a read-only duplicate and prompt-budget audit; honor namespaced plugin overrides and distinguish CLI discovery from desktop verification.
Select canonical installed tool contracts and complete registry, allow-rule and twin onboarding.
Use $systematic-debugging to investigate failures, bound edits, test a cause and verify a focused fix.
Use $react-best-practices for canonical React/Next.js rules and a focused correctness, accessibility and performance review.
Use $frontend-design to create, critique or polish interfaces with focused design references and existing project identity.
Use $cloudflare to build/deploy Cloudflare projects with shared product references and focused auth/deployment checks.
Use $agents-sdk for a requested or existing Cloudflare Agents stack; preserve provider choice.
Use $frontend-testing-debugging for rendered interactions, console/visual checks and verified owned-server cleanup.
Use $current-limiting-factor to identify the current constraint, evidence, smallest intervention and feedback signal.
Explicit-only: use $wwwwh for adaptive inquiry and selective judgment. Automatic invocation is disabled; comparative benefit remains unproven.
